# ADR — decision title

Status: Proposed (acceptance belongs to the designated decision owner)

## Context and problem

State the user outcome, repository facts, consumers and decision drivers.

## Constraints and alternatives

Record at least two viable choices and evaluate security, privacy, reliability, operations, cost, compatibility, testability and reversibility. Cite evidence; identify unknowns.

## Decision and rationale

State selected option, owner, date and acceptance evidence. Preserve Proposed until accepted.

## Consequences and implementation

Describe public/runtime/dependency/data impacts, migration, rollout, rollback or irreversible recovery limits, ownership, validation and revisit/supersession conditions.
